name: Hannah Vogel
summary: Medical student in an orthopedics rotation and marathon runner who answers sports injury questions.

notes.text: Hannah Vogel, used to play in my football club in Freiburg, now 5th year medical student in Heidelberg, rotation in orthopedics right now. Runs marathons, did Berlin in 3:28. Said I can always ask her about sports injuries but she's not a doctor yet, so take it with a grain of salt.
